visual_identity.core_identity: A predatory shapechanger disguised as a dungeon door, betrayed by a hidden eye, tongue-like handle, and organic warping in the wood.
visual_identity.silhouette: Mostly rectangular door silhouette fixed in a wall opening, with subtle bulging organic deformation.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate head; one concealed eye and a mouth or tongue integrated into door hardware or panel seams.
visual_identity.body_shape: Door slab and frame retain architectural structure while selected panels flex like living tissue.
visual_identity.surface: Simple wood panels and iron fittings with sparse organic seams.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one full rectangular door slab integrated into a doorway as the entire creature body. Keep hinges, frame alignment, and door panels readable; one hidden eye and tongue-handle emerge from existing hardware/panel seams only. No separate monster head, torso, arms, legs, chest body, or freestanding creature silhouette.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No separate biological limbs. Eye, tongue, mouth seam, or pseudopod detail must remain integrated into the door slab or its existing hardware while the door stays structurally attached in the opening.

accuracy_checks: door form and structural attachment remain readable
mimic does not become unrelated monster

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

physical_requirements: structural_attachment: disguised door body must occupy a believable supported opening; environment engine chooses the wall, frame, materials, and surrounding room
